m: Press one *comb* against another *comb*, teeth inward, and grind grain between them in a stone **mortar**.
A *white dove* flies over a *plank* counter carrying a crisp new **banknote** in its beak.
A *slide* of air hisses out as your bike limps down the *winding path* on a **flat tyre**.
Jump the *hurdle* with an egg in your hand, crack it, and out spills the golden **yolk**.
A curled vine bends like an *elbow* round a fat green **melon** hanging below.
Stand a statue on a *plank* raised up on two short legs: a stone **pedestal**.
Roll in the hot *soil* under the summer sun and you come home with **red cheeks**.
Hang two pans from a *plank* beam and see which side drops: a **balance scale**.
A *plank* of a tail, a beak and a wing, perched on a branch: a singing **bird**.
A *long sweep* of the brush bends left, then right, then away: a **winding path**.
Fill a pot between *two planks* and watch water trickle out in a *snake bend*: a **leaky pot**.
A tiny *drop* of a worm spins silk round and round itself into a **cocoon**.
A *little fortune stick* stands over bones lit by the *dusk moon*: an **old skeleton**.
Under the *teepee* the hungry hunters *glare* at the pot: they want their **food**.
Under the *plank* floor a *fortune stick* points down the steps: go **downstairs**.
Under the pale *moon* a dog digs up a long white **bone**.
Behind a *stop sign* of lips sit two rows of white **teeth**, ready to bite.
Push a *skewer* into the cloud and a *ski*-shaped zigzag crackles down: a **lightning bolt**.
Blow so hard that a *small table* flips and the *scissors* fly off it: that is the **wind**.
A *zigzag*, then a *zigzag*, then another *zigzag* ripple side by side: a **wavy river**.
Sharpen a long *hairpin* to a point and fix it to a shaft: a **spear**.
Under an *archway* of ribs hang slabs of red **meat** at the butcher's.
Tie a stalk of *wheat* to a blade and part the soil like *curtains*: a **plough**.
A *drop* of spring water trickles on and on, never stopping: a long **stream**.
A *prowling dog* with a sharp *claw* sniffs out its den at night: a **badger**.
Open a *treasure chest*, find two *horns* of a crown inside, all made of shining **gold**.
Fold a *towel*, lay a *ski*-shaped curl of hair on it, and sleep on your **pillow**.
A *drop* of clay, flattened and curved, slides into place on the roof: a **tile**.
A man steps behind a *plank* on his *crutch* and simply disappears: the **vanishing man**.
A *right hand* grips a *little fortune stick* and leans on it: a **tall cane**.
On top of a *tall stool* sits a *fence* of woven twigs: a **bird nest**.
Swing an *axe* into a *plank* of ground and a little mound rises: a grassy **hillock**.
Dig a *cave* with a *swan*-necked blade on a stick: a **shovel**.
A *bracket* of bone with a *lid* of feathers flaps on its own: a **single wing**.
Lay a *plank* flat, push a *pole* up under it, and it swings open: a **trapdoor**.
A *pole* of a stem pokes up out of a *pit* with two leaves: a **sprout**.
A wide *mouth* and a *lightning bolt* of a tongue snaps a fly: a hungry **frog**.
Lift the *lid* off the *cocoon* and the thread inside is black as night: **dark thread**.
A *kneeling man* taps the stalk and a *drop* swells where it joins: a **bamboo joint**.
Put a *boot* in a *grass basket* and spin it round: the whole **globe** rolls with it.
Climb the *tree* to the last *plank* at the very top: the **treetop**.
A *child* pokes a *ski* pole into the sand and leaves a round **hole**.
Unwind a *cocoon* and the loose strands hang down as a **silk tassel**.
A *right hand* stabs a *drop* of sausage with its prongs: a **fork**.
The *dodger* zigzags across the field with a *drop* of fluffy tail: a **rabbit**.
*Lifting hands* raise the boss from a *plank* in the ditch: his loyal **assistant**.
A black bird on a *plank* with one eye shut so you cannot see it: a **crow**.
Burn a *grain stalk* under the *sun* and sweet smoke curls up: **incense**.
Under the *awning* of hair a *spiral* of nose, eyes and mouth: a **face**.
A *slash* of a needle and an *elbow* of thread: just a **tiny thread**.
Two fawns side by side like *twins*, with branching antlers: a family of **deer**.
*Grey hair* on top, bent over a *spoon* of porridge: an **old man**.
Under the *roof*, stack every *plank* and sack on shelves: the **storeroom**.
A *plank* is chained to the leg of a pig so it can't run: a **shackled pig**.
A *pennant* snaps in the wind with a *drop* of rain flicked off: a **flapping flag**.
Put a *no sign* on a *plank* base and it stands firm like a **plinth**.
Go *downstairs* with a *snake bend* of a back, holding out a **begging bowl**.
*Two planks* of sky with an *elbow* of mist curling below: a fluffy **cloud**.
A big *mouth* on long *legs* tells you what to do: your **big brother**.
Sweep the *crumbs* off the steps of the tall roofed hall: the emperor's **palace**.
Your *big brother* puts on *horns* and swaps your coins for foreign ones: the **money changer**.
A *bent knife* hangs from a string and *crumbs* of glass tinkle below: a **wind chime**.
Ten generations, a *cross* on a grave, and a *mouth* that tells old tales: an **antique**.
Lift the lid of a box and *two planks* spring out on a coil: a **jack-in-the-box**.
*Grey hair* flying, up long before the *sun*, rushing from job to job: a **busy man**.
At *sunrise* your *thumb* flicks something shiny out of the sand: a **found coin**.
Kick the *soil*, push with your *elbow*, and head out the door marked **exit**.
A *nail* in the ceiling and a *mouth* below says yes: a **nodding head**.
Two feet stand on either side of a *cross*, copying each other: **mirror feet**.
Shake out a *little fortune stick* and read it with your *mouth*: the **fortune teller**.
*Trudging feet* stop at your *mouth* of a door: a **visitor** knocking.
A *blanket* tied to a pole, fluttering in the wind: a small **pennant**.
Lay *two planks* across *two planks* over a hole, and draw water from the **well**.
Under an *awning* a *fortune stick* is crossed out: a big **no sign**.
A *standing knife* bent into the curve of a crescent *moon*: a sharp **moon sickle**.
Rake the *soil* and press your *thumb* together in prayer: a quiet **temple**.
Shake *candy* in a wide shallow tray to blow the husks off: a **winnowing basket**.
The *tent* pole slides into a *mouth* below and snaps in place: a **fitted lid**.
Under the full *moon* a lonely *dog* sits on the hill and howls all night: the **moon dog**.
The *sun* peeks over a *cross* on the church, and up gets the **early bird**.
Climb the *podium*, open your *mouth*, and spray the crowd: a **spitting mouth**.
Plant a *stop sign*, set a *spoon* beside it: dig right here, **this spot**.
A *person* with *two planks* across his shoulders carries home the shopping: the **husband**.
Lift the *lid* off a cup, draw the *curtains*, and roll: two cubes of **dice**.
*Two planks* of a stamp press down on *legs* of metal: a round **yuan coin**.
An *eye* peeps out between two *curtains* of shell: an **old shell**.
A bird perched over the *embers*, warming its old feet: an **old bird**.
Under a *lid* of a helmet stands the smallest soldier on the board: a **pawn**.
A *fence* inside a fence inside a fence, winding inward: a **spiral**.
A fish grilled over the *embers*, the old-fashioned way: an **old fish**.
A man rushes out of the *teepee* with a *hairpin* of a horn to blow: the **herald**.
Climb a *tree* and keep one *eye* on the road: the **lookout**.
Clasp hands over the *hurdle* and step through the *curtains* together: **joined hands**.
Stick two *horns* on a cake, one on each side, then cut straight between them: each gets **half**.
Mark the *sun* with a *foot stop* line under it: right, a **tick mark**.
An *elbow* leans over the edge as a *mouth* sings to the crowd: the **stage**.
A *halberd* propped against a *cliff*, long-handled and heavy: a **pole axe**.
Stack *soil* upon *soil* and polish it to green stone: a **jade tablet**.
Pull the enemy by the *ear* with your *right hand*: a **grabbing hand**.
An *eye* peers into a box on two legs full of hammers: a **toolbox**.
One *person* walks ahead and another *person* copies every step behind him: the **follower**.
*Sprinkles* of paint fall on a canvas lit by the *moon*: a **portrait**.
Under her *slanted cap* a *mother* rushes from task to task: a **busy mother**.
A *big man* flicks *two sparks* of hair gel on top: a smart **hairdo**.
Wrap a *tree* of sticks tight and tie a *mouth* of rope round the middle: a **bundle**.
Roll the *dice*, then cross your legs like *scissors* to wait: **crossed legs**.
A *person* hears grunting, and out of the woods charges a tusked **wild boar**.
A *person* slips a ring on his thumb to pull the bowstring: an **archer's ring**.
Under a *lid* of a hat, drops fall on both sides: a **sweating man**.
An old *sun* wheel turns on its axle, creaking: an **old cart**.
The whole village squeezes under one big *tent* to talk and vote: an **assembly**.
Push up from a *pit* and a shoot breaks the square soil: a **sprouting field**.
Wrap a *blanket* around what came from her *mouth*: put it in a **quotation**.
Plant one *tree* beside another *tree*, then keep going, and soon you have a **grove**.
Pull out the *stacked drawers* and use the bottom one to dig: a **scoop**.
A *woman* piles her hair high and pins *rice* grains in it: a **tall bun**.
Pull out a *hairpin*, lower a *bucket* into the dark, and follow it down: a **tunnel**.
Bang a *knife* on a pot and shout with your *mouth*: the **town crier**.
Under the *awning* an *old shell* is pressed into paper: an **old page**.
An old horse gallops past, kicking up sparks from the *embers*: the **old horse**.
